name: Esteros del Iberá
story: Esteros del Iberá is located in the province of Corrientes, Argentina. It covers a total area of 15,000 to 20,000 square kilometers and is one of the largest wetlands in the world. It is home to a wide variety of fauna, including capybara, caimans, and over 350 species of birds.
matters: The park is a stronghold of the vulnerable marsh deer and includes protected areas that together form the largest conservation area in Argentina. A rewilding initiative has reintroduced native animals like the jaguar, pampas deer, and giant anteater to the region.
